goal: Reject unknown keys in the sendall RPC options parameter
Protects users from accidental wallet-wide spends or unintended broadcasts caused by typos
reviewability: Nothing known that would invalidate a review
agreement: Agreement on rejecting unknown options to prevent unintended behavior
Support for rejecting unknown fields explicitly instead of silently ignoring them (maflcko)
Verified by testing that misspelled options fail rather than broadcast on regtest (Zippo76)
Objection to removing solving_data addressed by keeping the option (polespinasa)
Open suggestion to add a release note for the validation change (kevkevinpal)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because typos in sendall options can trigger severe errors like spending all wallet UTXOs
Prevents accidental transaction broadcast when callers misspell options like add_to_wallet
